scope: Two representative native 640x360 side-by-side composites were personally reviewed; not all six samples, not a complete video or full-frame visual scan.

defects.description: BiRefNet retains the bright green floor ellipse as visible opaque foreground beneath both shoes. It is a wide background object clearly visible on both dark and blue composites, not an uncertain one-pixel antialiasing detail.

Green outlines around the cat ears and long hair are visibly thicker than the isnet baseline in the native dark-background comparison. The replacement semantic Alpha has not solved source edge contamination.

partial_improvement_not_approval: Face and white costume remain present in these samples, but retention of foreground anatomy does not offset a wide opaque green background object.
